core_concept: Flexbox is a CSS layout module that provides a way to arrange items in a container. It distinguishes between flex containers (elements with `display: flex`) and flex items (elements within a flex container).  Flexbox allows for flexible and responsive layouts by controlling the alignment, distribution, and ordering of items within a container, and supports nesting for complex designs.
technical_breakdown: Flexbox utilizes `display: flex` to define a flex container.
Flex items are elements directly within a flex container, and their behavior is controlled by flexbox properties.
Flexbox enables responsive layouts by allowing items to adapt to different screen sizes and container dimensions.
Flexbox supports both single-dimensional (one axis) and two-dimensional (both axes) layouts.
